clauses.clause: Every approved input has stable identity and provenance
clauses.evidence: 43 Rudy mission payloads have exact MAST IDs, byte sizes, SHA-256 values, FITS metadata, and query provenance; publisher references have source/output seals. LEGACY inventory-only candidates are explicitly barred from analysis until payload hashing.

clauses.clause: Canonical schemas and integrity tests pass
clauses.evidence: Closed schemas and dataclasses enforce units, finite/nonnegative uncertainty, mission/cadence compatibility, monotonic segment time, unique keys, round-trip serialization, and row-level lineage.
66 unique groups comprise 39 development, 13 internal validation, 13 final holdout, and Rudy as one descriptive benchmark; the assignment and source are SHA-256 sealed.

clauses.clause: Exact Rudy tutorial products are recorded and optional TESS ambiguity is nonblocking
clauses.evidence: The four-quarter tutorial query resolves to 10 monthly files; 33 TESS products are retained separately by pipeline/cadence, with missing QLP uncertainties explicit and optional.

residual_limits: Raw mission and publisher payloads are not redistributed.
Population candidates require payload SHA-256 verification before use.
The portable repository cannot provide confidential holdout identities; process and integrity controls apply.
